scene: A very wide panoramic view of smooth sand dunes with sharp curving crests rolling across the whole width to a flat horizon in the lower third, the dune crests flow continuously from left to right, on the crest of one large dune at about one third from the left edge sits a single tiny 1990s computer workstation, a small beige CRT monitor on a flat pizza-box style case with a keyboard, casting a long shadow, a vast empty sky above. No logos, no brand names, no text, no letters, no watermark.
